name: Castle Ardenvale
description: The ruined royal castle where Eriette holds her throne and the final battle occurs.

pages_say.description: The ruined royal castle, half-burned and abandoned.
The royal castle where Rowan's father tells her her blood awaits.
The ruined royal castle now filled with slumbering knights and Eriette's court.
The castle where Talion says Eriette will be found.
The ruined royal castle where Eriette holds her throne and the final battle occurs.
